entities.name: Philipp Forchheimer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philipp Forchheimer was an Austrian engineer, a pioneer in the field of civil engineering and practical hydraulics, who also contributed to the archaeological study of Byzantine water supply systems. He was professor in Istanbul, Aachen, and Graz.
